info.title: Ingestion Service
info.description:
Bulk data-ingestion and Excel-template-generation service for the E4H (eGov DIGIT) platform. It reads/writes Excel workbooks to bulk-create and validate facilities, vendors, boundaries, projects, staff/supervisor assignments, AMC configurations, and legacy incident tickets, orchestrating calls to the platform's MDMS, facility, project, HRMS, organization, boundary, field-plan, field-plan-activity, AMC-scheduler, localization, and incident-management services.

## Authentication & Authorization

This service does **not** use a bearer/`Authorization` header. Instead it follows the eGov DIGIT platform convention of embedding the caller's identity and JWT/authToken inside a `RequestInfo` object (see `RequestInfo` / `User` / `Role` schemas), which is:
- submitted as a JSON-encoded **string** in a `request_info` field of the `multipart/form-data` body on most `/ingestion-service/ingest/*` and `/ingestion-service/template/*` endpoints (parsed server-side by `request_info_from_json`), or
- submitted as the `RequestInfo` key of a JSON request body on the handful of endpoints that accept `application/json`.

Where an endpoint enforces authorization, it calls `get_authorized_request_info(request_info)` (`app/decorators/rbac_validator.py`), which:
1. returns `401 Unauthorized` if `RequestInfo.userInfo` or `userInfo.roles` is missing/empty;
2. returns `403 Forbidden` if none of `userInfo.roles[].name` matches a value of the `UserRole` enum (`app/core/user_role.py`) -- **currently the enum has a single member, `ADMIN`**, so in practice this check requires the caller to hold the `ADMIN` role;
3. otherwise returns the (still fully caller-supplied) `RequestInfo` unchanged.

Only 4 of the endpoints documented below actually invoke this check at runtime (marked 'Authorization: ... requires ... ADMIN' in their description): `POST /ingestion-service/ingest/legacy_ticket_ingestion`, `POST /ingestion-service/template/facilityWithStaff`, `POST /ingestion-service/template/facilityWithSupervisors`, and `GET /ingestion-service/template/facilitySelection`. On every other endpoint the same `get_authorized_request_info` call exists in the source but is commented out (or was never added), so no role is currently enforced -- this is called out per-endpoint below.

post.summary: Upload and ingest legacy tickets Excel file
post.description: Migrates legacy support tickets into the Incident Management service: maps each row's (Issue Type, Sub Type) pair via an uploaded mapping sheet, resolves the reporting employee/tenant (special-cased for Mizoram, by username, vs. other states, by NIN/HFR id) from the HRMS DB and MDMS tenant/block masters, builds an incident payload per row, and submits it to the IM service. Returns the workbook annotated with status/error/ticket_id/employee_info. **Authorization:** this endpoint calls `get_authorized_request_info(RequestInfo)`, which requires `RequestInfo.userInfo.roles` to contain at least one role whose `name` equals `ADMIN` (the only member of the `UserRole` enum). Returns 401 if userInfo/roles are missing, 403 if no role matches.

Generates a downloadable Excel template pre-filled with that data (no extra blank rows). **Authorization:** no role check is enforced by this endpoint at runtime (the `get_authorized_request_info` call is either absent or commented out in the current code); any caller that can reach the service can invoke it. A `RequestInfo` payload is still accepted/parsed for downstream calls to other eGov DIGIT services.

post.summary: Generate QR codes for facility auto-login
post.description: Looks up tenant/health-facility mappings for a fixed list of state tenants from MDMS, resolves each facility's HRMS employee login username from the HRMS Postgres DB directly, generates a QR-encoded auto-login URL image per facility (organized into state/district/block/facility folders), and returns a ZIP archive of the generated PNGs. **Note:** on failure this endpoint does not raise an HTTPException -- it returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body `{"status": "error", "message": "<error>"}` instead. **Authorization:** no role check is enforced by this endpoint at runtime (the `get_authorized_request_info` call is either absent or commented out in the current code); any caller that can reach the service can invoke it. A `RequestInfo` payload is still accepted/parsed for downstream calls to other eGov DIGIT services.

200.description: ZIP archive of generated facility login QR-code PNGs, OR (on internal failure) a JSON error body returned with HTTP 200.

get.description: Liveness/readiness probe backed by the `fastapi_health` library, running a single always-true check function (`is_healthy`). Returns HTTP 200 with one boolean per registered check when all checks pass, or HTTP 503 if any check fails (not currently reachable since the sole check always returns True). No RequestInfo/authentication is required.

200.description: All health checks passed.

503.description: Service unhealthy -- at least one registered health check failed.

Role.description: A single role assigned to a user, embedded inside RequestInfo.userInfo.roles. Authorization in this service is performed by scanning this list for a role whose `name` matches a value of the UserRole enum (currently only "ADMIN").

User.description: userInfo embedded inside RequestInfo. Carries the identity and roles of the calling user; there is no separate Authorization header in this service.

RequestInfo.description: The eGov DIGIT platform convention used across this service for both authentication context and authorization. There is no separate `Authorization` header: the caller's JWT/authToken and identity travel inside this object as `authToken` and `userInfo`. Endpoints that enforce RBAC call `get_authorized_request_info(request_info)` (see app/decorators/rbac_validator.py), which scans `userInfo.roles[].name` and requires at least one role matching the `UserRole` enum (app/core/user_role.py) -- currently only the single value `ADMIN`. On most multipart/form-data endpoints this object is submitted as a JSON-encoded string in a form field named `request_info` (parsed server-side via `request_info_from_json`); on JSON-body endpoints it is submitted as the `RequestInfo` key of the request body.

Boundary.description: Flattened block-level boundary row produced by app.schemas.boundary.flatten_boundaries from a nested boundary_data tree.

BoundaryTreeNode.description: A single node in the nested boundary_data tree accepted by template-generation endpoints (country -> state -> district -> block).

FilterType.description: Enum used by MDMS-driven column definitions to describe how a column's allowed values are constrained.

MDMSColumn.description: A single column definition returned by MDMS for a data-ingestion schema (e.g. data-ingestion.FacilityIngestionSchema).

FacilityIngestionSchemaResponse.description: Column-definition schema fetched from MDMS (data-ingestion.FacilityIngestionSchema / FacilityIngestionSchemaWithoutBoundaryCode / FieldPlanFacilityIngestionSchema) and used to build ingestion/template Excel sheets.

Vendor.description: A single vendor row parsed from the uploaded vendor Excel sheet, before being submitted to the organization service.

HTTPError.description: Standard error body raised via FastAPI's HTTPException(status_code, detail) in this service.

detail.example: Failed to process facility data: <underlying error message>

HTTPErrorObjectDetail.description: Variant of the standard error body where `detail` is a structured object rather than a plain string (used e.g. by /facilitiesValidateData when uploaded boundary codes do not match the project's boundary codes).

HTTPValidationError.description: FastAPI's default 422 body, produced automatically by Pydantic/FastAPI request validation (e.g. a missing required Form/File field).

HealthCheckResponse.description: Response produced by the fastapi_health library's health() helper: one boolean per registered check function.
